structured.approach: BE-03 asks me to confirm that the database changes the Backend tasks need are done. First I read the two contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design) to find any storage need for TSK-05 and TSK-06 in ap_aging. Then I checked the ap_aging checkout against the tool view: I listed its files with Glob, searched with Grep for database libraries, migrations, SQL and file I/O (no matches), and read aging.py and README.md. The design keeps storage out of scope and the repository has no database, so the required set of changes is empty and the outcome holds. I wrote task.db_changes with the evidence and what it means for BE-04 and BE-05. The step allows no shell commands, so a Bash call was denied by the G9 hook and I used Glob and Grep instead. I did not need any connectors.

claims.text: The design places storage, database and schema migration outside its boundary; the new data is one record key paid_date, one reject reason 'paid_date', and in-memory delay history, risk map, overdue rows and CT-1 JSON.
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage is introduced; only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
Every new function is pure and in-memory with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs (NF-10), and any storage or network call from the libraries would re-trigger DES-01.
TSK-05 and TSK-06 change only src/ap_aging/aging.py, src/ap_aging/__init__.py and a new tests/test_overdue.py, and TSK-06 adds no transport layer.
ap_aging has no database; no migrations exist or are required.
aging.py imports only datetime.date, decimal.Decimal and typing, and aging_buckets works on an in-memory iterable of invoice dicts.
ap_aging is a Python 3.9 standard-library package with code in src/ap_aging/ and tests in tests/.
paid_date is a key of the in-memory invoice record (DC-1) built by ap_pipeline under TSK-01. It is not a database column, and ap_aging ignores extra keys.

structured.summary: This feature needs no database changes for the Backend lane, and none are outstanding. The design (A1, DD-1, NF-10, A8) keeps storage, schema and migrations out of scope, and every new piece of ap_aging data stays in memory. ap_aging has no database: no migration, schema or SQL files and no database imports. So the step outcome holds because nothing was required, and BE-04 and BE-05 can go ahead with no dependency on database administrators or infrastructure. If a later change adds storage or a transport, it would re-trigger DES-01 and this step would need to run again. The output is at outputs/FEAT-ZD-48600/task.db_changes.md. A shell command was denied by the G9 hook because this step allows no shell, so I used Glob and Grep for the repository check instead.

tool_input.command: git ls-files && grep -rniE "sqlite|sqlalchemy|psycopg|migrat|database|CREATE TABLE|open\(" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./.codegraph" ; cat src/ap_aging/__init__.py
tool_input.description: List repo files and search for database usage
